text:
Maya (design): Quick ping — mock for a compact invocation preview in the Playground. Trying to show tool metadata, a short result snippet, and a small action row. Thoughts on hierarchy + accessibility? https://img.redwood/mock/invoke-compact.png

Diego (eng): Nice! Can we collapse the args list by default? long arg lists make cards huge. Maybe a "show more" affordance.

Samira (devex): Agree on collapse. Also prefer a single primary action label: current copy says 'Run' and 'Execute' in different places. Pick one. 'Invoke' might be clearer for tools?

Jules (a11y): A few a11y nits: 1) ensure the card has role="article" and an accessible name (tool name + status). 2) keyboard focus order: primary action should be first tabbable control. 3) for live results use aria-live="polite" on the snippet container.

Maya (design): Good calls. On copy, leaning toward 'Invoke' to disambiguate from Playground "Run" which is for prompts. Diego — collapse by default but show a 2-line preview?

Diego (eng): 2-line preview + chevron to expand sounds good. Implementation detail: avoid layout shift when expanding — animate height and keep max-height clipped.

Samira (devex): UX question: should the invocation preview show structured output JSON collapsed into a single-line summary, or render key fields inline? Example we discussed earlier: 

```
{"status":"ok","result":{"id":123,"title":"Invoice draft"}}
```

Maybe render as "ok — Invoice draft (id:123)" with a little JSON icon that opens the full object in a panel.

Jules (a11y): If we provide a one-line summary, make sure the expansion control has aria-expanded and aria-controls attributes and that the full JSON panel receives focus when opened. Also add a skip link for keyboard users to jump to the full output.

Maya (design): Love the one-line summary + JSON icon approach. For the summary copy, suggestion: "ok — Invoice draft (id: 123)" vs "Invoice draft — ok". Which is clearer?

Diego (eng): Put the object type first: "Invoice draft — ok" reads cleaner when scanning a history list. Sorting/search will likely surface by title.

Samira (devex): Small layout debate: history list uses denser rows; previews currently use 12px meta text which hits contrast limits on dark mode. We should increase to 13-14px or make the color higher-contrast. Also make sure line-height stays >= 1.2.

Jules (a11y): Yes, WCAG contrast is non-negotiable. Also validate with VoiceOver/JAWS that truncated summaries are still read with full accessible name.

Maya (design): Copy tweak: action menu currently says 'Show full output' — change to 'View full output' per microcopy guidelines? 'View' seems more passive and less noisy. Thoughts?

Diego (eng): 'View full output' works. For telemetry, can we fire an event when users expand JSON? want to track how often they inspect structured outputs.

Samira (devex): +1 for telemetry. Also ask: should expanded JSON open as a modal or as an inline drawer? Modal interrupts context but is simpler for keyboard focus traps. Inline drawer is lighter but more engineering work.

Maya (design): Preference for inline drawer anchored to the card so users can inspect multiple invocations quickly. We'll prototype both for edge-case testing.

Jules (a11y): If inline drawer, ensure it's announced properly (role="region" with aria-label) and that focus returns to the invoking control when closed.

deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded for playground/compact-invoke v1 — build 20240322.

Samira (devex): I'll update the PR description with these decisions (collapse by default, 2-line summary, 'Invoice draft — ok' order, 'Invoke' primary action, 'View full output' secondary, inline drawer, telemetry for expand). Can we sync on mocks tomorrow?

Maya (design): Yes — I'll post high-fidelity files in Figma and drop a link here. Thanks for fast feedback :thumbsup:
